_comment: STATUS-jas item 37, launch half: state.brushes_open_libraries is initialised at startup from
preferences.brushes.persistent_libraries (state.yaml), one open, expanded section per slug, in the
preference's order; when the list is empty, the declared fallback [{id: default_brushes, collapsed: false}].
Each runner's open_libraries_at_launch(slugs) is pinned here, and its state defaults apply it to the
CURRENT preferences (the bundle with the user's overrides).
